segments.text:
Thys muſt we alwayes conſider that our Sauiour
Chriſt ſayd vnto Pilate, that his kingdome is not of this world, no man can ſée how it ſpringeth or ſpreadeth: & how ſoeuer the children of this kyngdome be diſperſed or ſcattered, and be neither named nor knowen in the world, yet is it certayne that this kyngdome of God and hys Chriſt remayneth ſafe & ſound, though neither Eliah nor any other man can ſée it, and that this kyngdome ſhall ouercome all powers that ſtand vp agaynſt it.
